onGrid.name: On-grid
onGrid.why: Lowest cost per unit, with the PM Surya Ghar subsidy. Surplus power earns credit through net metering.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.why: Grid savings by day plus a battery that keeps essentials running through power cuts. Subsidy-eligible for homes.

offGrid.name: Off-grid
offGrid.why: A battery-backed system that runs fully independent of the grid, day and night.

subsidy.eyebrow: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
subsidy.heading: Up to *₹78,000* back on your home's rooftop
subsidy.intro: The central government's rooftop scheme pays a subsidy on grid-tied home systems, and some states add their own top-up on top. SAEL checks your eligibility at the free consultation, then handles the application, the DISCOM approval and net metering as part of our end-to-end liaisoning.
handles: State top-ups, where your state offers one

calculator.label: Subsidy estimate
calculator.note: Residential rooftop only. State top-ups change often: SAEL confirms the final amount at your free consultation.

engineering.heading: Light in. *Lower bills* out.
engineering.body: Every system uses Tier-1 modules and BIS-certified components, matched to the site and sized to your actual consumption. The same engineering team builds everything from a 1 kW home system to utility-scale plants.

dayNight.text: Homes and shops with a steady grid go on-grid. Homes with frequent power cuts go hybrid, and the battery carries them through.
